prompt: Original friendly fantasy creature design, full body on white. A red-orange bipedal reptile companion with smooth simple rounded anatomy, ivory belly and muzzle, amber eyes, low swept ivory forehead crest and small indigo cheek fins. Two arms and two legs, both arms held away from the chest in a clear balanced stance. One forearm slightly larger, with a smooth curved indigo kite membrane attached along its outer side and a thin golden bamboo rim. One short indigo dorsal sail. A short tail ends in a gold cord with two ivory-and-indigo chevron tabs. Cheerful confident expression with a small tooth. Crisp clean 2D manga line drawing with flat saturated colors and a single cel shadow. Simple broad shapes, minimal interior lines. No crumpled paper, accordion folds, geometric plates, texture, armor, weapons, background scenery or text.
review: Estudo de simplificação. Corpo claro e contínuo, mas rosto e proporções ficaram delicados demais para a evolução jovem. Rascunho intermediário não selecionado como direção; não substituir bebê ou criança.

prompt:
An original Soulmonsters fantasy creature concept: Tramassauro, an orange-and-indigo bipedal reptilian partner with a distinctive asymmetric wind-catching forearm. One complete character in three-quarter view, white background, generous margins. Polished clean 2D manga animation model art with expressive confident linework and flat saturated colors, one firm cel shadow.
A strong broad chest, short neck, compact waist, sturdy bent legs and big three-toed ivory feet. Two arms held apart from torso. The arm on the viewer's left is larger: a thick smooth forearm with an integrated indigo curved kite surface, an ivory blunt front rim and one graceful golden bamboo arc running from elbow to wrist. Its three-fingered reptile hand remains visible at the end. The opposite arm is slimmer, with three ivory-tipped fingers. One gold knot at the larger elbow explains the tension structure. A single small indigo swept triangular sail grows from the upper back. This asymmetry is the memorable focal feature, balanced by the feet and short tail.
Long trapezoid reptile muzzle, angular jaw and nasal bridge, warm ivory lower face, narrow amber almond eyes with a brave playful expression. A low swept ivory forehead keel and two short indigo cheek fins preserve family identity. Head smaller relative to chest than a small companion, but still expressive. No tall horn, bulky helmet or massive grin.
Body surfaces are smooth and continuous, orange with a calm ivory chest and belly, indigo forearm and heel accents. One diagonal material seam crosses the side of the belly; otherwise no repeated folds. Kite material appears in just the forearm tension panel, the dorsal sail and a connected gold-cord tail with two ivory-and-indigo chevron tabs. The body is visibly alive and substantial. The kite regions have taut broad surfaces and a few deliberate structural edges, not crumpled paper or folded polygon body.
Poised open stance, one foot ahead, head turned attentively toward viewer. Carefully designed manga creature with clear joints and negative spaces, balancing organic body and constructed kite anatomy. Avoid bare generic lizard, excessive paper wrapping, accordion shapes, faceted tessellation, armor suit, weapons, texture noise, airbrushed gradients, realistic rendering, text and scenery. All four limbs, both feet and both tail tabs visible.
review: Duas pernas, dois braços com mãos visíveis, uma vela dorsal e duas abas de rabiola. Corpo tem volumes contínuos, um único vinco abdominal e foco no antebraço assimétrico. O antebraço aparece com membrana envolvendo o membro; continuidade de raiz requer perfil antes de rig. Garras da mão distante ficam parcialmente ocluídas. O rosto e o tom de laranja variaram em relação à criança por geração textual, não preservação de pixels. Há sombreamento suave residual. Direção agora pende mais para anatomia orgânica; equilíbrio final com pipa segue em avaliação, sem resolver por mais vincos.
